entries.6b3d95c545f8c82d: Its strength is that it has a collection network that allows payments 24 hours a day, 365 days a year at most of the approximately 56,800 convenience stores in its partner network nationwide (as of June 2026), and that businesses can use a system in which payment data is delivered on the business day after payment and deposits are matched automatically, without contracting with each collection agency individually. It also has an operating track record since it began convenience store bill payment agency services in 1997.

entries.70d10bd6b0ca54e0: This is a service that handles remittances from businesses to consumers on their behalf. The account information needed for remittance is entered by the recipient themselves, and because the account is confirmed to exist before the remittance is sent, there are no reversed transfers (kumi-modoshi) and funds arrive quickly; these are its features. People without a bank account can also receive cash at convenience stores.

The fees charged to businesses consist of an initial setup fee, a monthly basic fee, a fee per payment and others.
